name: axhub-web help (drafts)
description: Help mode entries for axhub-web. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Passes
entries.text: Timed passes: while one is active, the calls it covers run at once instead of waiting on a veto countdown. Grant, extend and revoke them here.

entries.title: Pass
entries.text: Which pass this row is: what it covers, who granted it and when it ends.

entries.title: Ran under a pass
entries.text: Shows only the log entries for calls that ran under a pass instead of waiting for approval.

entries.title: min from now
entries.text: Moves the pass's end to that many minutes from now.

entries.title: Its calls
entries.text: Lists every call that ran under this pass.

entries.title: Service
entries.text: The service the pass covers; * covers every service.

entries.title: Scope (control@1 target; * matches anything)
entries.text: Narrows the pass to a control@1 target such as tokens.theme; * matches any target.

entries.title: Tools (empty = every tool in the scope)
entries.text: Narrows the pass to these tools; leave it empty for every tool in the scope.

entries.title: What for
entries.text: Why the pass is granted. It is kept in the audit log with the pass.
